contracts.summary: Shopify store setup on Dawn theme with 5 core pages, 40 product CSV import, retail checkout, Mailchimp signup, basic SEO, and 2 design revision rounds on home and product pages. All custom B2B, multi-language, multi-currency, and maintenance are excluded.

clauses.text: Included deliverables: Shopify store on Dawn theme, 5 pages (Home, Shop, Product, About, Contact), 40 products CSV import, Shopify Payments retail checkout, Mailchimp footer signup, and basic SEO.
Revision limit: 2 design revision rounds on Home and Product pages. Additional revision rounds or revisions on other pages are billed at the contract hourly rate.

Explicit exclusions: Copywriting, custom photography, wholesale/B2B pricing or wholesale checkout, multi-language localization (e.g. French/Spanish), multi-currency (e.g. CAD, EUR), and ongoing maintenance.
Additional scope: Any work outside Section 1 and Section 2 will be documented in a Change Order at $65/hr.
